description: This file defines a class EmbeddedBlockChunker for chunking text into blocks with respect to fences and paragraph boundaries, along with related utility functions for safe text breaking points, and types for chunking configuration and fence splits.

classes.name: EmbeddedBlockChunker
classes.description: A class for managing buffered text and chunking it into smaller pieces based on fence spans, paragraph, sentence, or newline boundaries, with support for forced chunking and fence handling.

methods.name: findSafeSentenceBreakIndex
methods.description: Finds a safe index to break a sentence, considering fence spans and minimum character count.

methods.name: findSafeParagraphBreakIndex
methods.description: Finds a safe index to break a paragraph, considering fence spans, minimum characters, and direction.

methods.name: findSafeNewlineBreakIndex
methods.description: Finds a safe index to break at a newline, considering fence spans and minimum characters.

methods.name: skipLeadingNewlines
methods.description: Skips over leading newline characters in a string starting from a given index.

methods.name: stripLeadingNewlines
methods.description: Removes leading newlines from a string.

methods.name: findNextParagraphBreak
methods.description: Finds the next paragraph break in text, considering fence spans and minimum characters.
